youtube.title: Why Can You Hear Your Name in a Crowd? 👂 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
This is called the cocktail party effect. Your brain constantly filters background voices without you noticing. Your own name is so familiar and important that it can break through that filter, so you notice it even when you were not listening.

Subscribe to The Hidden Why for a new why every day.
